Diagnostic compilation/testing now passes: 38 affected JVM checks (6 new observer, 15 engine, 11 export, 6 control), 8 acquired-image runner checks and 21 Scala.js checks (6 observer, 15 engine), plus the four fixed-audit Python tests. The initial runner compilation rejected a discarded Path return under -Werror; explicitly returning Unit fixed it, and the runner was rebuilt/tested. The initial sandbox sbt lock failure is retained separately. The observer tests establish exact synthetic optimizer-state/trace neutrality, cross-level snapshot limits, detached buffers, rejected-state retention and failure propagation. Real-image neutrality remains to establish.

Predeclaring five observed pairs for D01: required OASIS 11-to-12, 13-to-14 and MMRR-21 11-to-12, plus OASIS 1-to-10 and 17-to-18 as representative previous selected-policy successes in bidirectional Dice and HD95 versus affine. Replay exactly two existing policies: selected control and step-scaled-fine1.5. Capture level starts/ends, accepted updates 1/2/5/10/15/20, and rejected absolute attempts 1/2/6, with a hard 24-state budget across levels. No new policy or fresh subject is introduced. First run only OASIS 11-to-12 selected control and require byte-identical final forward/reverse maps and validity before panel expansion. Source, compiled classes, inputs, manifest and driver will be sealed before that replay. Diagnostic timings include checkpoint overhead and cannot support production speed claims.
